clue.text: Vehicle to kill for, it's said

indicators.note: it's said tells the solver the word for killing is heard spoken rather than written

parts.note: to slay is to kill

explanation.surface: Someone covets a car so much they would commit murder for it.
explanation.definitionFit: A sleigh is a sledge drawn over snow, a vehicle on runners.

clue.text: Fly around, left of the sun

indicators.note: around means the flying word wraps about the letter for left

parts.note: to soar is to fly high

explanation.surface: An insect buzzes around, then departs from the sun.
explanation.definitionFit: Solar is the adjective relating to the sun.

clue.text: Attractive, topless and creating an impression

indicators.note: topless means the word loses its top, its first letter, in a down answer

parts.note: fetching means attractive

explanation.surface: Someone attractive goes topless and makes a striking impression.
explanation.definitionFit: Etching is making a print by engraving a plate with acid, creating an impressed image.

clue.text: Rock salt under lab rig being processed

indicators.note: under places the sailor after the rearranged letters in a down answer
being processed means the letters of lab rig are worked over into a new order

parts.note: a salt or tar is an old sailor

explanation.surface: Rock salt sits beneath laboratory equipment being run.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being processed' rearranges LAB RIG into GIBRAL. The Rock is the nickname of Gibraltar.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rock is the familiar nickname for the British territory at the mouth of the Mediterranean.

clue.text: Compound used for grass when harvesting starts

parts.note: grass is slang for cannabis, also called pot
as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

indicators.note: starts asks for only the opening letter of the word harvesting

explanation.surface: A farming chemical is spread on grassland as the harvest begins.
explanation.definitionFit: Potash is a potassium compound, used chiefly as fertiliser.

clue.text: Stars performing around port

indicators.note: around means the performing word wraps about the port

parts.note: a performer who is on is performing
Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port

explanation.surface: Celebrities perform in a harbour town.
explanation.definitionFit: Orion is a constellation, a group of stars.

clue.text: A small phone that's right in the loft

parts.note: tel is the short form of telephone
ie means that is

explanation.surface: Someone has left a small phone up in the attic.
explanation.definitionFit: An atelier is an artist's studio, often a top-floor workroom.

clue.text: Tough — a doctor's patients are difficult people to deal with

parts.note: tough means hard
a doctor's patients are referred to as cases

explanation.surface: A doctor finds the patients awkward and demanding.
explanation.definitionFit: A hard case is a tough, uncooperative person.

clue.text: Unpleasant smell on location? This may be the cure!

indicators.note: in an across answer, one piece placed on another follows it, so the smell comes after the location

parts.note: a location is a place
BO is body odour, an unpleasant smell

explanation.surface: Someone recommends a bad smell at a certain spot as a remedy.
explanation.walkthrough: The exclamation and question mark flag the joke: a dummy pill only seems to cure because the patient believes in it.
explanation.definitionFit: A placebo is an inert pill that may make a patient feel better purely through belief.

clue.text: Problem raised with origin of murder weapon

indicators.note: Problem here treats the following word as something to be worked out, so its letters are jumbled
origin of asks for the opening letter of the word murder

explanation.surface: A difficulty comes to light about where a murder weapon came from.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Problem raised' looks like a reversed synonym, but 'Problem' is the anagram signal: RAISED rearranged gives SIDEAR, and M follows.
explanation.definitionFit: A sidearm is a pistol or sword carried at the belt, a weapon.

clue.text: Blair came out with two houses

indicators.note: out signals the letters of the preceding two words spread and rearranged

explanation.surface: Tony Blair emerged owning a pair of homes.
explanation.walkthrough: Tony Blair, former UK prime minister, fits a parliamentary surface: a legislature with two chambers.
explanation.definitionFit: A bicameral parliament has two chambers, such as Commons and Lords.

clue.text: Single source of rice -ration it out, causing annoyance

parts.note: single means one, the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: source of asks for the opening letter of the word rice
out signals the preceding words being spread out and rearranged

explanation.surface: Rationing the only supply of rice causes resentment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges RATION and IT into RITATION, which follows I and R.
explanation.definitionFit: Irritation is a feeling of being vexed, a synonym of annoyance.

clue.text: Small part of chain without a break?

indicators.note: break means the word chain is broken up, its letters rearranged once the a is removed

explanation.surface: A small link from an unbroken chain is described.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' removes the A from CHAIN, and 'break' rearranges the remaining CHIN. A chain is an old measure of 22 yards, and this unit is a small part of it.
explanation.definitionFit: The chain is an old surveying length of 66 feet, so this small unit of length is a tiny fraction of it.

clue.text: Mean to get drunk

explanation.surface: Advice for a miser who wants to get drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Tight means stingy with money, and is also slang for intoxicated.

clue.text: Thoughtful group putting spare keys initially on the cistern

indicators.note: in a down answer the tank piece goes on the end of the earlier pieces

parts.note: spare means lean or thin

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of the word keys

parts.note: a cistern is a water tank

explanation.surface: People hide spare keys on top of the toilet cistern.
explanation.definitionFit: A think tank is a body of experts gathered to produce ideas and policy.

clue.text: Star's gamble on free seat

indicators.note: in an across answer, the gamble placed on the seat letters comes after them
free here means loosened from its order, so the letters of seat are rearranged

parts.note: a gamble is a risk

explanation.surface: A celebrity bets on getting a free seat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'free' rearranges SEAT into ASTE; 'Star's' is read as 'Star is'.
explanation.definitionFit: An asterisk is the printed star symbol used to mark a footnote.

clue.text: Consumed by 11 and avoiding excess

indicators.note: by places the eating word beside and after the 11 word

parts.note: the number points to 11 across, defined there as annoyance, a sense also given by temper
consumed means ate

explanation.surface: Something is eaten up by annoyance, yet stays moderate.
explanation.definitionFit: Temperate means moderate and self-restrained.

clue.text: Clothing that's put on tarry

indicators.note: put on places one piece after another in an across answer

parts.note: to tarry is to linger, to stay longer
ie, from Latin id est, means that is

explanation.surface: Clothing that gets smeared with tar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tarry' looks like the adjective meaning covered in tar; it is the verb, to stay.
explanation.definitionFit: Lingerie is women's underwear, a kind of clothing.

clue.text: Fruit given to Greek wrestler might do it

parts.note: an apple is a fruit

explanation.surface: A Greek wrestler is handed a piece of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: To grapple is to grip and struggle, as wrestlers do.

clue.text: Goes and finds one cut out of American pictures

indicators.note: cut out of means removing the single letter from the films word

parts.note: movies is the American word for films
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A person leaves after finding a scene cut from American films.
explanation.definitionFit: Moves and goes are both verbs for changing position, or taking a turn in a game.

clue.text: Wild flower found around the north

indicators.note: around means the flower is placed about the letter for north

parts.note: a violet is a flower
N is the abbreviation for north

explanation.surface: A wild flower is discovered growing in the north.
explanation.definitionFit: Violent means wild and uncontrolled in force.

clue.text: Food that may be eaten by fine artist

parts.note: OK means fine
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: Something to eat that a refined painter might consume.
explanation.definitionFit: Okra is a green vegetable pod eaten in gumbo and curries.

clue.text: Transport offered by a drama teacher

parts.note: the stage is the world of drama
a coach is a tutor or teacher

explanation.surface: A drama teacher offers someone a lift.
explanation.definitionFit: A stagecoach was a horse-drawn carriage that carried passengers between towns.

clue.text: Source of value in exclusive work out

indicators.note: in means the letter is placed within the exclusive word

parts.note: sole means exclusive, as in sole rights

indicators.note: Source of asks for the opening letter of the word value

explanation.surface: Someone works out where value lies in an exclusive deal.
explanation.definitionFit: To solve a problem is to work it out.

clue.text: Shout about game being up for groom

indicators.note: about means the shout wraps around the game letters

parts.note: a shout is a cry

indicators.note: being up in a down answer means the game letters read upwards, backwards

parts.note: RU is rugby union, a game

explanation.surface: Someone shouts about a game that has finished while tending a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: To curry a horse is to groom it with a currycomb.

clue.text: Embryonic prince before being kissed?

parts.note: in the fairy tale a frog becomes a prince when kissed, so a very young frog is a prince at an embryonic stage

explanation.surface: A fairy-tale prince in his earliest form, before the kiss.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a young frog, and in the fairy tale a kissed frog turns into a prince.

clue.text: Runs wildly, calling and starting to shoot

parts.note: a calling is a vocation or career

indicators.note: starting to asks for the opening letter of the word shoot

explanation.surface: Someone dashes about frantically as their vocation begins to take off.
explanation.definitionFit: To career is to rush along headlong and out of control.

clue.text: Tower requiring royal guardian

parts.note: a keep is the main tower of a castle
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the royal cipher

explanation.surface: A castle tower needs a guardian appointed by the crown.
explanation.definitionFit: A keeper is a custodian who looks after something.

clue.text: Watch nurse have a go

parts.note: SEN is a State Enrolled Nurse, an old British nursing grade
to have a go is to try

explanation.surface: A nurse is encouraged to attempt something while being watched.
explanation.definitionFit: A sentry keeps watch as a guard.
